_readme: Curated corrections to NVD CPE assignments for WordPress CVEs, keyed by CVE id.
Used by import_nvd_wordpress.py. Each entry either remaps the CVE to the real
wordpress.org slug ({"slug": ..., "type": plugin|theme}) or drops it ({"drop": true}).
Only add an entry when the evidence (reference URL, vendor advisory) is explicit;

CVE-2021-24159.reason: NVD CPE is rocklobster:contact_form_7 (Contact Form 7 <=3.1.9) but the only references (WPScan 363182f1, Wordfence blog 'unpatched-vulnerability-50000-wp-sites-must-find-alternative-for-contact-form-7-style') describe the separate, closed 'Contact Form 7 Style' plugin.
